ValidationRule.description: This validation rule prevent user to save the case record until Other Closure Reason text is populated when Cancellation/Closure Reason is 'Other reason'
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $User.LastName <> "Integration" && ISPICKVAL(Type,'Credit Card Account Closing') && ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c,'Credit Card Account Closing') && ISPICKVAL(Closure_Reason__c, 'Other reason') && ISBLANK(Other_Closure_Reason__c)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Other Closure Reason is mandatory for 'Other reason' closure
